definitions.explanation: The process of developing, training, or nurturing people, skills, or organisms to maturity or competence. Used for human resource development, talent cultivation, and biological cultivation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{育成|いくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put effort into developing young players.

examples.japanese: {人材|じんざい}{育成|いくせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: This training program aims to develop the next generation of leaders.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in business, sports, education, and government contexts. More systematic and institutional in nuance than ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧, which is the everyday verb for raising/nurturing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人材|じんざい}{育成|いくせい} (human resource development)
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{育成|いくせい} (player development)
- {育成|いくせい}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (development plan)
- {育成|いくせい}⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧ (development program)
- {後進|こうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{育成|いくせい} (training successors)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{養成|ようせい}→養成：14655_yousei⟧: training, development (specifically for producing qualified professionals)
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: education (broader; includes general schooling)
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: raise, bring up (everyday verb; less formal and more personal)
